title: Recurring scheduled charge updated
description: Event generated when a recurring charge is updated.

recurring_charge_link_id.description: The link which generated the following charge

account_id.description: The account identifier associated with the charge

statement_id.description: The statement identifier associated with the charge

examples: The actual status which triggered the event.

created_at.description: Charge creation date and time in ISO-8601 format

updated_at.description: Charge update event date and time in ISO-8601 format

processing_code.description: Charactere sequence that represents a group of resultant transactions.

examples: Description of the recurring charge plan.

cycle.description: The cycle associated with the following charge

secondary_processing_code.description: Charactere sequence that represents a group of resultant transactions.

examples: Description of the  secondary item of the recurring charge plan.

cid.title: Correlational ID of event
cid.description: This is not a unique value, so different events (from same domain+event_type or not) can share same cid. This is usefull to identify all events produced from same request or processing.
